data.name: Start
data.value:
👋 Hey! I'm Message Board Bot.
I turn your Telegram messages into an organized Kanban board. Send or forward me a message, and I'll add it as a card.
How it works: 1. Send or forward a message 2. 👍 = added to your board 3. Edit the message and I'll react with ❤ and update the card (deleting the message won't delete the card)
📖 Docs: https://laraue.com/blog/documentation/laraue-boards
🔍 Search from any chat: type @msgboard_bot followed by your search, right in the message field.
Full-text search, sorting, filtering, and more — right from your boards: {0} (also available as a Mini-App 👇)
